local_answers.label: Local grounded answers
local_answers.description: Turn VidXP search evidence into cited answers on this computer. Setup reuses Ollama when available or downloads a private headless runtime and the approved Qwen 3.5 4B model.

worker.label: Process videos on this computer
worker.description: Run background indexing, search, and grounded questions locally. This includes all built-in search features and is the normal desktop setup.

browser.label: Browser interface
browser.description: Use VidXP's visual workspace in your default browser. It stays private to this computer unless you explicitly share it without authentication.

mcp.label: AI assistant integration
mcp.description: Use VidXP from an MCP-compatible AI assistant installed on this computer.

server.label: App integration service
server.description: Connect other apps through VidXP's private local API. Local-network sharing is optional and requires bearer-token authentication.

media_runtime.reason: Startup checks verify the system FFmpeg runtime and offer a consented package-manager command; bundling remains disabled until target-specific codec licenses and provenance are recorded.
